name: Colorado Power Electronics, Inc
old_description: Colorado Power Electronics (CPE) is a manufacturer of high voltage equipment.
about:
Colorado Power Electronics (CPE) was incorporated in 1996 in Fort Collins, Colorado. The company was founded by Geoff Drummond, who remains the owner. Drummond brought experience from designing high-volume power supplies for the plasma thin-film industry, and he established CPE to provide high-voltage equipment to the traveling-wave tube (TWT) manufacturing sector for military and space applications.

CPE manufactures high-voltage power supplies with low stored energy, solid-state pulsers, TWT solid-state modulators, and ion thrusters including ion engines and Hall thrusters. The firm also offers custom analog and mixed-signal design solutions. In-house capabilities cover PCB design and layout, PCB assembly, system assembly, test and calibration verification, and a fully equipped R&D laboratory. The company emphasizes customized solutions tailored to specific application requirements.

CPE’s products are used by manufacturers of military and space TWTA test stations and ion implanters. The company also serves the thin-film industry, where its high-power DC and pulser products are described as the market leader for both U.S. and European sales. Additional industrial applications round out the customer base.

CPE differentiates itself through its focus on customized high-voltage solutions, supported by an in-house R&D and service laboratory. The founder holds several patents for power converters and plasma thin-film processes. The company also provides a service center, training programs, technical application notes, and product manuals to support customers throughout the product lifecycle.
